g.text: GEARS added post hoc; known held-out identities and public GO were used.
One GEARS seed; C3 flow seeds share one representation; controls are reused.
MSE excludes each target gene after normalization.
GEARS and training mean predict log expression, not a count distribution.
Internal same-study comparison; not an external blind or official challenge test.
